title: FTX claim buyers and marketplaces map
scope: Four companies: ClaimBao, FTX SELL and Qredax, which state they buy claims directly, and Xclaim, which runs a marketplace. Not a complete list of the market.
notes: Every statement is quoted word for word from the company's own website (first-party) and shows what the company says, not the result of a check by this project.
'checked' is the date the source page was read. A null statement means the information was not found on the pages reviewed.
No prices, rankings or scores are published.

roleStatement.statement: We buy bankruptcy claims, mainly FTX claims, from creditors, including creditors in countries where the estate can't pay them.

focus.statement: We buy FTX claims from creditors in countries where FTX can't pay out, and pay in USDT or USDC.

coverage.statement: We buy FTX claims from creditors in countries where FTX can't pay out, and pay in USDT or USDC.

exclusions.statement: We can't buy from sanctioned persons.

payoutRails.statement: USDT or USDC to your wallet on the date in the contract.
